name: Metaball Mercury
desc: Luminous liquid-metal metaballs merge and split as seven charges orbit, an implicit field banded into chrome-teal-to-magenta iso-shells with a bright specular highlight so the molten blobs glow against a dim indigo ground.

scale.doc: blob radius vs design size (higher = fatter merged mass)

style.doc: render philosophy: chrome-teal/magenta + highlight / orange gooey heat / glowing iso-shells / iridescent oil / mono ink

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
